map.：输入：左前降支钙化面积 40 mm²、峰值 320 HU（系数 2）；回旋支面: : inputs: left anterior descending calcification area 40 mm² with peak 320 HU (factor 2); circumflex area 15 mm² with peak 160 HU (factor 1); right coronary area 20 mm² with peak 250 HU (factor 2). The tool outputs an Agatston total of 40x2+15x1+20x2 = 155, a tier of moderate (100-399) and a suggestion of a moderate-to-high intensity statin plus lifestyle for an intermediate-risk population. Note: it only indicates risk; medication is decided by a physician.
